examples.text: kammaṃ kamman'ti ñatvāna, vipākañ'ca vipākato, paṭicc'uppannadhammānaṃ, yathāvālokadassano, mahākhemaṅ'gamo santo, pariyosānabhaddako'ti.

76556.commentary: (THa) jātimadena mattohan'ti ahaṃ udicce brāhmaṇakule nibbatto, na mādiso ubhato sujāto añño atthī'ti kulamānena matto mānathaddho acārin'ti yojanā.

examples.text: jātimadena matto'haṃ, bhogaissariyena ca, saṇṭhānavaṇṇarūpena, madamatto acāri'haṃ.

76557.meaning1: beautiful outward appearance; attractive external form
76557.commentary: (THa) saṇṭhānavaṇṇarūpenā'ti saṇṭhānaṃ ārohapariṇāhasampatti, vaṇṇo odātasāmatādichavisampatti, rūpaṃ aṅgapaccaṅgasobhā. idhā'pi vuttanayena yojanā veditabbā.

examples.text: jātimadena matto'haṃ, bhogaissariyena ca, saṇṭhānavaṇṇarūpena, madamatto acāri'haṃ.

76558.meaning1: intoxicated with pride (about); drunk on conceit (over)

examples.text: jātimadena matto'haṃ, bhogaissariyena ca, saṇṭhānavaṇṇarūpena, madamatto acāri'haṃ.

76559.grammar: masc, from na atta, atta group, neg
76559.commentary: (THa) n'āttano samakaṃ kañcī'ti attano samakaṃ sadisaṃ jāti'ādīhi samānaṃ atirekaṃ vā kañci na maññisaṃ na maññiṃ, mayā samānam'pi na maññiṃ, kuto adhikan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: n'āttano samakaṃ kañci, atirekaṃ ca maññisaṃ, atimānahato bālo, patthaddho ussitaddhajo.

76560.meaning1: slain by pride; injured by arrogance
76560.commentary: (THa) atimānahato bālo'ti bālo ahaṃ tato bālabhāvato atimānena khat'ūpahatakusal'ācāro

examples.text: n'āttano samakaṃ kañci, atirekaṃ ca maññisaṃ, atimānahato bālo, patthaddho ussitaddhajo.

76561.meaning1: full of oneself; with oneself held high
76561.commentary: (THa) patthaddho ussitaddhajo thambhavasena garūnam'pi nipaccakārassa akaraṇato bhusaṃ thaddho anonamanathaddhajāto ussitamānaddhajo.

examples.text: n'āttano samakaṃ kañci, atirekaṃ ca maññisaṃ, atimānahato bālo, patthaddho ussitaddhajo.

76562.grammar: nt, act, from na onamati, neg

examples.text: mātaraṃ pitarañ'c'āpi, aññe'pi garusammate, na kañci abhivādesiṃ, mānatthaddho anādaro.

76564.meaning1: type of egotism; variety of conceit

examples.text: atimāno ca omāno, pahīnā susamūhatā, asmimāno samucchinno, sabbe mānavidhā hatā'ti.

76565.meaning1: having conquered; having overpowered; having forced into submission

examples.text: yadā navo pabbajito, jātiyā sattavassiko, iddhiyā abhibhotvāna, pannag'indaṃ mah'iddhikaṃ.

76566.meaning1: lord of the serpents; king of the snakes

examples.text: yadā navo pabbajito, jātiyā sattavassiko, iddhiyā abhibhotvāna, pannag'indaṃ mah'iddhikaṃ.
sāriputta imaṃ passa, āgacchantaṃ kumārakaṃ, udakakumbham'ādāya, ajjhattaṃ susamāhitaṃ.

76568.commentary: (THa) attahitaparahitānaṃ sādhanato sādhunā katakiccena anuruddhena sādhu ubhayahitasādhako, suṭṭhu vā ājañño kārito damito.

examples.text: ājānīyena ājañño, sādhunā sādhukārito, vinīto anuruddhena, katakiccena sikkhito.

76569.commentary: (THa) attahitaparahitānaṃ sādhanato sādhunā katakiccena anuruddhena sādhu ubhayahitasādhako, suṭṭhu vā ājañño kārito damito.

examples.text: ājānīyena ājañño, sādhunā sādhukārito, vinīto anuruddhena, katakiccena sikkhito.

76570.meaning1: thrown off; cast off; discarded; abandoned

examples.text: vātarog'ābhinīto tvaṃ, viharaṃ kānane vane, paviddhagocare lūkhe, kathaṃ bhikkhu karissasi.

76571.meaning1: accomplished in the delicacy of meditation; succeeded in the fine skill of deep meditative calm
76571.commentary: (THa) jhānasokhummasampanno'ti jhānasukhumabhāvena samannāgato. jhānasukhumaṃ nāma arūpajjhānaṃ, tasmā aṭṭhasamāpattilābhimhī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tena attano ubhatobhāgavimuttitaṃ dasseti. apare pan'āhu, sokhumman'ti aggamaggaphalesu adhipaññāsikkhā adhippetā, tato jhānaggahaṇena attano ubhatobhāgavimuttitaṃ vibhāvetī'ti.

examples.text: bhāvento satta bojjh'aṅge, indriyāni balāni ca, jhānasokhummasampanno, viharissaṃ anāsavo.
vātarog'ābhinīto tvaṃ, viharaṃ kānane vane, paviddhagocare lūkhe, kathaṃ bhikkhu karissasi.

76573.meaning1: accomplished in delicate meditation; succeeded in subtle states of deep meditative calm; (comm) also having the formless attainments
76573.commentary: (THa) jhānasokhummasampanno'ti jhānasukhumabhāvena samannāgato. jhānasukhumaṃ nāma arūpajjhānaṃ, tasmā aṭṭhasamāpattilābhimhī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tena attano ubhatobhāgavimuttitaṃ dasseti. apare pan'āhu, sokhumman'ti aggamaggaphalesu adhipaññāsikkhā adhippetā, tato jhānaggahaṇena attano ubhatobhāgavimuttitaṃ vibhāvetī'ti.

examples.text: bhāvento satta bojjh'aṅge, indriyāni balāni ca, jhānasukhumasampanno, viharissaṃ anāsavo.

76574.synonym: ābhāti, tapati, dibbati, pakāseti, bhāsati, sobhati
76574.commentary: (THa) accimanto'va pabhāsayantī'ti dīpasikhāvanto viya jalitaaggī viya vā obhāsayanti sabbā disā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: aṅgārino dāni dumā bhadante, phalesino chadanaṃ vippahāya, te accimanto'va pabhāsayanti, samayo mahāvīra bhāgī rasānaṃ.

76575.commentary: (THa) vippamuttaṃ kilesehī'ti paṭippassaddhivimuttiyā sabbakilesehi vimuttaṃ, tato eva suddhacittaṃ

examples.text: vippamuttaṃ kilesehi, suddhacittaṃ anāvilaṃ, abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhanto, viharissaṃ anāsavo.

76576.commentary: (THa) khippaṃ niggaṇha satiyā, kiṭṭh'ādaṃ viya duppasun'ti tathā dhāvituṃ adento yathā nāma puriso kiṭṭh'ādaṃ sassakhādakaṃ duppasuṃ duṭṭhagoṇaṃ yottena thambhe bandhitvā attano vase vatteti, evaṃ satiyā satiyottena samm'ādhithambhe bandhanto khippaṃ sīgham'eva niggaṇha, yathā kilesavigamena nibbisevanaṃ hoti, tathā damehī'ti.

examples.text: sace dhāvati cittaṃ te, kāmesu ca bhavesu ca, khippaṃ niggaṇha satiyā, kiṭṭh'ādaṃ viya duppasun'ti,

76577.commentary: (THa) maccun'ābbhāhato loko'ti ayaṃ sabbo'pi sattaloko coro viya coraghātakena, sabbavaṭṭanipātinā maccunā maraṇena abhihato, na tassa hatthato muccati.

examples.text: maccunā-abbhahato loko, jarāya parivārito, taṇhāsallena otiṇṇo, icchādhūpāyito sadā.

76578.commentary: (THa) pattadaṇḍo'va takkaro yathā takkaro coro kat'āparādho vajjhappatto atāṇo rāj'āṇāya haññati, evam'ayaṃ loko jarāmaraṇehī'ti dasseti. (PMa) pattadaṇḍo'ti rāj'ādīhi laddhaāṇo.

examples.text: maccun'ābbhahato loko, parikkhitto jarāya ca, haññati niccam'attāṇo, pattadaṇḍo'va takkaro.

76579.commentary: (THa) āgacchant'aggikhandhā'vā'ti mahāvane ḍayhamāne taṃ abhibhavantā mahantā aggikkhandhā viya maccu byādhi jarā'ti ime tayo anudahan'aṭṭhena aggikkhandhā imaṃ sattalokaṃ abhibhavantā āgacchanti

examples.text: āgacchant'aggikhandhā'va, maccu byādhi jarā tayo, paccuggantuṃ balaṃ n'atthi, javo n'atthi palāyituṃ.

76580.meaning1: to go out to meet; to advance against
76580.commentary: (THa) tesaṃ pana paṭibalo hutvā paccuggantuṃ abhibhavituṃ balaṃ ussāho n'atthi

examples.text: āgacchant'aggikhandhā'va, maccu byādhi jarā tayo, paccuggantuṃ balaṃ n'atthi, javo n'atthi palāyituṃ.

76581.meaning1: that much less; less by that amount
76581.commentary: (THa) yaṃ yaṃ vijahate rattiṃ, tadūnaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ ayaṃ satto yaṃ yaṃ rattiṃ vijahati nāseti khepeti, tadūnaṃ tena ūnaṃ tassa sattassa jīvitaṃ hoti. etena rattikkhayo nāma jīvitakkhayo tassa anivattanato'ti dasseti.

examples.text: amoghaṃ divasaṃ kayirā, appena bahukena vā, yaṃ yaṃ vijahate rattiṃ, tadūnaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.

76582.commentary: (THa) āsīnasayanassa vā'ti āsīnassa sayanassa vā, nisinnassa nipajjantassa vā'ti attho. āsīdanan'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, tattha sāmiatthe upayogavacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

examples.text: carato tiṭṭhato vā'pi, āsīnasayanassa vā, upeti carimā ratti, na te kālo pamajjitun'ti.

76583.grammar: nt loc sg of itthirūpa, comp, irreg form of itthirūpasmiṃ
76583.meaning1: in the feminine form; in female appearance
76583.construction:
itthi + rūpa + asmiṃ > asmi
itthirūpa + asmiṃ > asmi

examples.text: rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā, pañca kāmaguṇā ete, itthirūpasmi dissare.

76584.commentary: (THa) tassa mātā mālukyā nāma, tassā vasena mālukyaputtotv'eva paññāyittha. so vayappatto nissaraṇ'ajjhāsayatāya ghar'āvāsaṃ pahāya paribbājakapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā vicaranto satthu santike dhammaṃ sutvā sāsane paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karonto nacirass'eva chaḷabhiñño ahosi. so ñātīsu anukampāya ñātikulaṃ agamāsi. taṃ ñātakā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena parivisitvā dhanena palobhetu'kāmā mahantaṃ dhanarāsiṃ purato upaṭṭhapetvā idaṃ dhanaṃ tava santakaṃ, vibbhamitvā iminā dhanena puttadāraṃ paṭijagganto puññāni karohī'ti yāciṃsu.
76584.notes: Theragāthā verses 399-404 (TH6.5, TH214) are attributed to him.

examples.text: uruveḷakassapo ca, thero tekicchakāri ca, mahānāgo ca kullo ca, mālukyo sappadāsako.

76585.commentary: (THa) kā uppatti? ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinitvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde kapilavatthusmiṃ suddh'odanamahārājassa purohitaputto hutvā nibbatti, tassa sappadāso'ti nāmaṃ ahosi.
76585.notes: Theragāthā verses 405-410 (TH6.6, TH215) are attributed to him.

examples.text: uruveḷakassapo ca, thero tekicchakāri ca, mahānāgo ca kullo ca, mālukyo sappadāsako.

76586.commentary: (THa) kā uppatti? ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikāro tattha tattha bhave puññāni upacinitvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde rājagahe brāhmaṇakule nibbattitvā vayappatto vijjāṭṭhān'ādīsu nipphattiṃ gato nhātakalakkhaṇayogena nhātako'ti paññāyittha. so tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā rājagahassa tiyojanappamāṇe ṭhāne araññ'āyatane nīvārehi yāpento aggiṃ paricārayamāno vasati. tassa satthā ghaṭe viya padīpaṃ haday'abbhantare pajjalantaṃ arahatt'ūpanissayaṃ disvā assamapadaṃ agamāsi. so bhagavantaṃ disvā haṭṭhatuṭṭho attano upakappananiyāmena āhāraṃ upanesi.
76586.notes: Theragāthā verses 435-440 (TH6.11, TH220) are attributed to him.

examples.text: kātiyāno migajālo, jento sumanasavhayo, nhātamuni brahmadatto, sirimaṇḍo sabbakāmī ca, gāthāyo caturāsīti, therā c'ettha catuddasā'ti.
alaṅ'katā suvasanā, māladhārī vibhūsitā, alattakakatāpādā, pāduk'āruyha vesikā.

76588.commentary: (THa) pāduk'āruyha vesikā'ti ekā rūp'ūpajīvikā itthī yathāvuttavesā suvaṇṇapādukā paṭimuñcitvā ṭhitā'ti vacanaseso.

examples.text: alaṅ'katā suvasanā, māladhārī vibhūsitā, alattakakatāpādā, pāduk'āruyha vesikā.

76589.commentary: (THa) pādukā oruhitvānā'ti pādukāhi otaritvā, suvaṇṇapādukāyo omuñcitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: pādukā oruhitvāna, purato pañjalīkatā, sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā, mhitapubbaṃ abhāsatha.

76590.commentary: (JAa) mhitapubbañ'cā'ti paṭhamaṃ mhitaṃ katvā pacchā bhāsanto mhitapubbam'eva bhāsasi

examples.text: pādukā oruhitvāna, purato pañjalīkatā, sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā, mhitapubbaṃ abhāsatha.
pasannamukhavaṇṇo'si, mhitapubbañ'ca bhāsasi, hoti kho maraṇakāle, edisī vaṇṇasampadā'ti.

76591.commentary: (JAa) mhitapubbañ'cā'ti paṭhamaṃ mhitaṃ katvā pacchā bhāsanto mhitapubbam'eva bhāsasi

examples.text: pādukā oruhitvāna, purato pañjalīkatā, sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā, mihitapubbaṃ abhāsatha.

76592.commentary: (THa) ambāṭakārāme'ti evaṃnāmake ārāme. so kira chāy'ūdakasampanno vanasaṇḍamaṇḍito ramaṇīyo hoti tena pare'ti visesetvā vutto. ambāṭakavane ambāṭakehi abhilakkhitavane'ti ca vadanti.

examples.text: pare ambāṭak'ārāme, vanasaṇḍamhi bhaddiyo, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, tattha bhaddo'va jhāyati.

76594.meaning1: observances and activities; rituals and behaviours
76594.commentary: (THa) vatacariyāhī'ti, evaṃ katvā puttaṃ labhissathā'ti vuttaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, khīraṃ pāyitvā, anasan'ādivatacaraṇehi. (JAa) vatacariyāhī'ti dānasīlauposathakammehi.

examples.text: ekaputto ahaṃ āsiṃ, piyo mātu piyo pitu, bahūhi vatacariyāhi, laddho āyācanāhi ca.

76595.grammar: nt, act, from na asana, neg

examples.text: te ca maṃ anukampāya, atthakāmā hit'esino, ubho pitā ca mātā ca, buddhassa upanāmayuṃ.

76597.meaning1: having ordained; having made ordained; having given ordination (to)

examples.text: pabbājetvāna maṃ satthā, vihāraṃ pāvisī jino, anoggatasmiṃ sūriyasmiṃ, tato cittaṃ vimucci me.
pabbājetvāna maṃ satthā, vihāraṃ pāvisī jino, anoggatasmiṃ sūriyasmiṃ, tato cittaṃ vimucci me.

76599.meaning1: come out of solitude; emerged from meditation
76599.commentary: (THa) nirākatvā'ti attanā samāpannaṃ phalasamāpattiṃ appetvā tato vuṭṭhāya. ten'āha paṭisallānavuṭṭhito'ti.

examples.text: tato satthā nirākatvā, paṭisallānavuṭṭhito, ehi bhaddā'ti maṃ āha, sā me ās'ūpasampadā.
